status_semantics: For exclusion criteria, MEETS means the patient appears clear of the exclusion; DOES_NOT_MEET means the exclusion appears to apply.

labels.rationale: Only basal-cell carcinoma is documented, which the criterion excepts. 'No history of blood cancer' does not rule out other malignancies. Excluding on the basal-cell carcinoma is a false exclusion; clearing from absence is unsafe.

Pembrolizumab was discussed and declined, never started. That rules out pembrolizumab only, not other PD-1 or CTLA-4 agents. Excluding on the mention is a false exclusion; clearing from absence is unsafe.

FOLFIRI given 2026-04-08 (infusion record) and cycle 1 day 1 scheduled for 2026-04-20 (screening letter): 12 days apart, inside the 4-week window. UNKNOWN is acceptable because the scheduled date could move; clearing it (MEETS) is unsafe.
KRAS G12C mutation documented on the pathology report.
Colorectal adenocarcinoma documented (liver biopsy and oncology note); prior Hodgkin lymphoma or basal-cell carcinoma must not confuse the diagnosis.
